preparations.title: Herb-baked fish fillets
preparations.method: Heat the oven, put the cod in a baking dish, season with garlic, parsley, lemon, oil, salt and pepper, and bake until just cooked through. Cool slightly, then divide into boxes for the week.

preparations.title: Lemon roast potatoes
preparations.method: Parboil the potatoes, toss with oil, lemon, garlic, oregano and salt, then roast until crisp. Box them while hot for the meals that need starch.

preparations.title: Roasted courgettes and peppers
preparations.method: Cut the vegetables into chunks, toss with oil, salt and pepper, and roast until browned at the edges. Keep Tino's portion separate on the tray so the vegetables do not touch each other.

preparations.title: Tomato and cucumber rice salad
preparations.method: Cook the rice, spread it out to cool, then mix with chopped cucumber, tomatoes, spring onions, lemon, oil and salt. Pack it the same day it is cooked so it is eaten within the safe window.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven. Put the potatoes on first to parboil while you trim and tray the peppers, courgettes and onion. Slide the potatoes and vegetables into the oven, then season the fish and bake it near the end so everything finishes together. Cool, then box each preparation separately.
Cook the rice, spread it out so it cools quickly, chop the cucumber, tomatoes and spring onions, then mix and box the salad for the same day.
